title: How Much Departure Delay Can a Last-Mile Route Absorb?
grain: One stop in a complete route, including its row of the fixed travel-time matrix
dataset: Amazon Last Mile Routing Research Challenge, public model-build inputs
question: How late can a dispatcher release a route while still honoring its published windows and a stated end of shift?
design: Select six UUID-ordered high-rated routes of 45–145 stops from each of four depots before inspecting time windows. Evaluate the driver order and two classical route-improvement searches at the same move budget. Use backward time propagation for feasible witnesses and independent relaxation bounds for the largest possible delay. Report a station held out of design and a common zone disruption.
boundary: Package time windows and driver sequences are observed. Travel times are a provided static matrix, service durations are planned, and the depot-return deadline is an eight-hour scenario. Unsolved routes remain undetermined.
redistribution: Derived numerical extracts from Amazon under the research challenge CC BY-NC 4.0 data license, with attribution; see upstream license.
